card.name: Punctuation and numbers near blood pressure
card.fires_on: Punctuation, spaces and digits inside numeric or list-like spots in text about blood pressure, hypertensive crisis, or pressure and oxygen settings. Examples are the slash and digits in BP >165/105 and the space before a number in dose rates.
